additionalInfo.description: SmartHome automation engine. Xu ly: (1) device telemetry → SmartHomeConditionNode (multi-device batch query) → SmartHomeBulkCommandNode (parallel RPC); (2) asset telemetry bulk_command → SmartHomeBulkCommandNode truc tiep tu app.
Loc msg type. Chi xu ly Post telemetry / Post attributes — 2 loai co the mang telemetry cua device hoac asset.
Phan nhanh: device telemetry di kiem tra automation rules; asset telemetry co bulk_command di xu ly lenh truc tiep tu app.
Lay UUID chinh xac cua device vao metadata.originatorId. SmartHomeConditionNode se dung originatorId de biet day la device nao dang gui telemetry (de merge voi du lieu batch query).

Di nguoc tu Device → Room → Home theo chieu 'TO' (Device la TO trong relation 'Room Contains Device'). Doc server attribute 'automations' tren Home Asset, luu vao metadata.homeAutomations de SmartHomeConditionNode xu ly.

additionalInfo.description: Thoat som neu khong co automation rules. Tranh goi SmartHomeConditionNode khong can thiet.

CUSTOM NODE (com.smarthome.rule.condition.SmartHomeConditionNode).
Batch query TimeseriesService.findLatest() cho tat ca device IDs xuat hien trong conditions cua tat ca rules.
Merge voi telemetry hien tai cua trigger device (tu msg body).
Evaluate tung condition: device_state (so sanh gia tri), time_range, day_of_week, device_offline.
Output:
- 'Matched': co it nhat 1 rule triggered → msg body = { triggeredRules, triggerDeviceId, triggerDeviceName, timestamp }
- 'No Match': khong co rule nao khop
- 'Failure': loi parse JSON hoac loi DB query

Flatten tat ca actions tu tat ca triggered rules vao 1 queue (array). Lay action dau tien lam current msg (EXECUTE_ACTION), luu phan con lai vao metadata.pendingActions de Next Action node xu ly tuan tu.
Phan nhanh theo loai action. Ca device_command (1 device) lan bulk_command (nhieu devices) deu di qua SmartHomeBulkCommandNode vi node do tu xu ly theo mode.
Normalize device_command va bulk_command ve cung input format truoc khi vao SmartHomeBulkCommandNode: { mode, device_ids|room_asset_id|home_asset_id, command, params, filter_type }.

CUSTOM NODE (com.smarthome.rule.command.SmartHomeBulkCommandNode).
Doc mode tu msg body:
- 'device_list': gui RPC toi danh sach device IDs cu the
- 'room': RelationService.findByFromAndTypeAsync(roomAssetId, 'Contains') → danh sach device → gui parallel
- 'home': di qua tung room → collect tat ca devices → gui parallel
Gui ToDeviceRpcRequest(deviceId, command, params) truc tiep theo UUID, khong can originator swap.
Output:
- 'Success': tat ca devices thanh cong
- 'Partial Success': mot so thanh cong (continueOnPartialFailure=true)
- 'Failure': tat ca fail hoac loi query relations
Cho X giay (lay tu msg.seconds neu co, mac dinh 5s) truoc khi xu ly action tiep theo. Dung cho automation co action kieu 'delay'.
Tao alarm kieu 'SmartHome Notification' cho action 'send_notification'. App doc alarm history de hien thi lich su thong bao.
Pop action tiep theo tu metadata.pendingActions. Tat ca branches (bulk success, bulk partial, delay, notification) hoi tu ve day. Output EXECUTE_ACTION neu con action, NO_MORE_ACTIONS neu het.

True → con action → loop lai Action Type Router de xu ly.
False → het action → Build Log de luu ket qua tong hop.
Tao log entry sau khi tat ca actions hoan thanh thanh cong. Luu vao telemetry key 'automation_log' tren Home Asset. App doc de hien thi lich su automation.
Luu automation_log vao timeseries cua originator (Home Asset neu la direct command, hoac device neu la automation). TTL = 30 ngay.
Tao log entry khi co loi (tu SmartHomeConditionNode Failure hoac SmartHomeBulkCommandNode Failure). Luu vao cung key 'automation_log'.
Luu failure log vao timeseries. TTL = 30 ngay.
Xu ly direct bulk_command tu app (qua Asset telemetry API). Unwrap msg.bulk_command, dat pendingActions='[]' (chi co 1 action, khong loop), roi di thang toi SmartHomeBulkCommandNode.
